articles.title: Livestream shopping is fun and frictionless, but are there enough consumer safeguards?
articles.content: These days, Ms Adelphia Lim, 32, winds down most nights by watching shopping livestreams. She finds the on-screen interactions captivating, with the host animatedly showcasing a product while responding to viewers' questions in real time. The whole experience is fun and frictionless, she said
